heading: Notice of provisions of subchapter
lead: The Secretary shall prescribe a form of application for hospital treatment and domiciliary care which shall include notice of the provisions of this subchapter.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1991—Pub. L. 102–40 renumbered section 5227 of this title as this section. Pub. L. 102–83 substituted “Secretary” for “Administrator”.
